variants.prompt: A confident, striking young beauty with fiery red hair, emerald eyes, and porcelain skin, exudes a bold, commanding presence. Clad in a fitted black sweater and high-waisted distressed denim jeans, she stands with one hand on her hip, the other trailing along the edge of a pool deck as she looks out over the crystal-clear waters. Her intense gaze and slight smirk convey a sense of dominance, matched by her powerful, athletic build and the way her boots sink into the gravel beneath her feet, captured in a tight, medium shot.
